method: The listed brown rice quantity is the dry, uncooked weight. Follow the cooking and assembly steps below for this measured portion.

Wash and dice the mixed peppers. Use ready-to-eat canned sweetcorn, drained before weighing; keep both ready for assembly.
Use already-boiled, cooled eggs. Peel them and cut them into thin slices; the listed weight is the edible egg without shells.
Stir together all the measured tomato ketchup, chilli powder, paprika, cider vinegar and olive oil in a small bowl to make the dressing. Keep it refrigerated until assembly.
